events.comment: The content (chapters, traumas, gifts…) comes from assets/data/content.json, built from the 2D game. The save lives in the browser storage and is merged over the defaults of the global variable Save.
A chapter starts: its colours, props, the angel, the HUD and the intro card. Gifts of the run start from zero (Miecz Ducha at level 1); Fruits of the Spirit are lasting.
Props: obstacles scattered on the ring, never at the centre where the angel starts.
The intro card: the sphere, the chapter, its lie.

parameters: "Przetrwaj trzy fale cieni i zburz twierdzę. Stój, aby Słowo leciało; uderzaj (spacja), zanim cień podejdzie; Ogień Ducha (E) ładuje skupienie."
"Przetrwaj trzy fale cieni i zburz twierdzę. Stój, aby Słowo leciało; uderzaj przyciskiem z gwiazdą, zanim cień podejdzie; płomień to Ogień Ducha, ładowany skupieniem."

events.comment: Everything the gifts of this run and the Fruits of the Spirit change, recomputed when a gift is taken.
Shields of faith and tongues of fire: as many objects as the gift level asks for.
Arrows move by themselves; WASD is mapped onto the same controls. On touch screens the joystick (left thumb) drives the same Top-down movement behavior.
Standing still is prayer: the Word flies and focus grows (Ps 46,11).
Focus (standing still, or the Mendi band — MendiFocus extension) charges three flames. One flame: a tongue of fire around the angel (Dz 2,3). Three: Pentecost.

parameters: min(3, Flames + Tuning.fireBase * MendiFocus::ChargeFactor() * St.fireMul * TimeDelta())
"Za mało ognia: stań w ciszy, by go rozpalić"

events.comment: Archero: while the angel stands still, the Word flies at the nearest shadow in range (FireBullet extension: cooldown, fan of Words for Rozmnożenie chlebów).

parameters: "Twierdza jest skuta łańcuchami: rozbij je ciosem!"
"Twierdza jest skuta łańcuchami: rozbij je ciosem!"

events.comment: Endless Puncher: strike (Space / J / the star button / a click) when a shadow is within reach. Strikes in a row build a combo that multiplies damage and light; a strike at nothing breaks it and costs a moment.
The stone always flies at the strongest shadow in range (the one with the most strength left).
Each trauma moves by its archetype (from Content.traumas): chase, circle, charge, drift, tank, split, blink, ranged. None of them are maze ghosts: they come in waves around the angel.
Circle: orbit for a while, then strike.
Charge: walk, wind up (a moment to strike it first!), dash.
Drift: come close, then hover sideways — despair and loneliness keep their distance.
Blink: doubt vanishes and reappears somewhere near.
Ranged: the Accuser keeps away and throws fiery arrows (Ef 6,16).
Touching a trauma wounds the angel (unless grace still protects it).
A trauma whose strength is gone breaks: light flies out and its truth rises (Lęk → Ufność).
Survivors: each level pauses the fight and offers 1 of 3 gifts (Content.gifts) not yet at their highest level.
Three waves of about a minute; shadows come from beyond the edge of the view, faster as the wave goes on. Then the Sabbath: rest, light flies to the angel, one heart returns.

events.comment: Shock waves: a ring of light that grows to its radius and vanishes.
The music follows the fight: the chapter's piece, more layers with more shadows, the boss scene for the stronghold (Psalm150 extension).
Hearts, flames, light and level on the left; wave and pause on the right; focus at the bottom; the stronghold and its lie at the top.
Touch controls sit by the screen edges whatever the width.
